paras: Thank you again, friend. I've been acquainting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.
I've heard... Less than charitable things about adventurers thus far in my travels. I'm pleased that those insinuations are quite unfounded.
You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
